newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Laing cuts ICI estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Laing cuts ICI estimates.

text.p: Earnings estimates for Imperial Chemical Industries Plc were cut on Thursday at Credit Lyonnais Laing, traders said, ahead of third quarter results from the chemical giant due on October 24.
The stock was down 20p at 855-1/2 by 1105 GMT, after yesterday closing at its highest level since May.

ICI was also undercut by a statement from ICI Australia that its profits for the year ended September 30 were likely to below the previous year's level, though analysts said the statement had only repeated a previous profit warning.
